# Download our 2025 App + keep your phone charged

**Published:** 17th June 2025 | **Source:** Glastonbury Festivals Technology News

The official Glastonbury 2025 mobile application, powered by Vodafone, is now available for download on iOS and Android. The app is designed to help festival-goers navigate the 1,500-acre site and plan their ultimate weekend.

### Key App Features
- **Personal Line-up Planner:** Bookmark favourite artists, preview stage times, and receive notifications before performances start.
- **Interactive GPS Map:** Search stages, food traders, medical tents, water points, and pinpoint your tent or meeting spots.
- **Live Location Sharing:** Safely share location with your festival group and sync schedule favorites with friends.
- **Worthy FM & Spotify:** Stream live Worthy FM radio and listen to stage-curated Spotify playlists.
- **My Highlights:** Track step counts and receive a personalised recap of stages and artists visited over the weekend.

### Vodafone Connect & Charge Tent
Located opposite the Leftfield area, the Vodafone Connect & Charge tent provides vital power and network services:
- **Free Mobile Charging:** Open to all festival-goers regardless of which mobile network provider they use.
- **Battery Pack Rental:** Attendees can rent a portable battery pack on-site and exchange it once a day for a fully charged replacement for free. Deposits are refunded upon return at the end of the festival.
- **Free eSIM Trials:** Visitors can activate a free 7-day 5G data eSIM trial via in-app links or QR codes at the Vodafone tent.
- **Enhanced 5G Capacity:** Vodafone deployed 10 mobile masts across Worthy Farm to deliver high-speed 5G connectivity.
